'''Yoichi Nishijima''' (Japanese: '''西嶋陽一''' ''Nishijima Yōichi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Nishijima was born sometime on March 2 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He started working on the {{pkmn|animated series}} with {{aniseries|JN}}, voicing [[Professor Amaranth]].

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
===={{aniseries|PTS}}====
* [[Professor Amaranth]]

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
* Wonder White (''The Wonderful 101'')
* Dokugozu (''Project X Zone'')
* Alain (''Golgo 13'')
* Egon Innkeeper (''Claymore'')
